info.title: Gifted Mind School Portal API
info.description:
Multi-tenant school portal API.

**Authentication.** Log in with `POST /auth/login`; the response sets an httpOnly `session` cookie.
Swagger UI cannot set cookies with the Authorize button, but when `/docs` is served from this API origin,
calling `POST /auth/login` with Try it out sets the cookie and later calls carry it.

**Authorization.** Every school-scoped endpoint takes its school from the session, never from the request.
Route guards check a permission; service guards additionally require a strictly higher role rank than the
target. Granting a role requires the role to be ranked below you **and** to grant only permissions you hold.
Each operation's description states its permission and rank rule.

**Errors.** Every failure uses `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Cross-school IDs return the same
`404` as nonexistent ones. `401` is used both for a missing session and for failed login; the body never
distinguishes an unknown email from a wrong password.

**Pagination.** List endpoints return `{ data, pagination: { limit, offset, total, hasMore, nextCursor } }`.
The audit log uses `pagination.nextCursor` for opaque cursor paging.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login, logout, password change, and the current identity. Login is email + password only; a user with several active memberships gets a school picker before a session is created.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Members of the caller's school. Every `:id` is a **membership** ID, never a global user ID. Requires `users:*` permissions; destructive actions also require a strictly higher rank than the target.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Per-school roles and their permission grants. Requires `roles:read`, `roles:assign`, or `roles:manage_permissions`. The owner role is locked.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Append-only, school-scoped audit history. Requires `audit:read`. Cursor-paginated by `(created_at, id)`.

tags.name: Calendar
tags.description: Academic sessions and terms. Requires `calendar:manage` for transitions and locks. Reads use `academics:read` once the calendar read endpoints land.

tags.name: Levels
tags.description: School levels (JSS 1–SS 3 and any custom level). Reads use `academics:read`; create/edit/archive use `structure:manage`. Archived rows are read-only.

tags.name: Classes
tags.description: Per-session classes `(level, arm, track)`. Reads use `academics:read`; create/edit/archive use `structure:manage`. Archived rows are read-only.

session.name: session
session.description: Opaque session cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. httpOnly; the raw token is never exposed to JavaScript. Log in via Swagger UI first, then use Try it out.

roles.description: Role keys held at the active school

permissions.description: Effective permission set (union of all roles)

temporaryPassword.description: Present only when a NEW user was created. Absent when an existing user was linked to this school. Known low-severity enumeration vector; see SECURITY.md.

id.description: Membership ID (not the global user ID)

roles.description: Role keys held at this school

rank.description: 1–100; higher is more authority. The client uses this to hide unassignable roles.

name.description: Actor's name, or `System` for platform actions

post.description:
Two login shapes, exactly one per request: (a) `email` + `password`, or (b) `username` + `schoolSlug` + `password`. Providing both or neither is a 400. `schoolSlug` is required with `username` because usernames are unique per school, not globally. 

**Email flow:** if the user has more than one active membership and no `schoolSlug` is supplied, no session is created — the response has `kind: select_school` and the client retries with a slug.

**Username flow:** the `(schoolSlug, username)` pair identifies the membership directly, so no `select_school` step occurs. Used by students without an email address.

On success a `session` cookie is set and the response has `kind: success`. Every failure returns the same `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` body, and unknown identifiers are verified against a dummy hash so response time does not reveal whether the account exists.

email.description: Email login. Mutually exclusive with `username` — provide exactly one.

username.description: Username login (used by students without email). Requires `schoolSlug` — usernames are unique per school.

schoolSlug.description: Required when using `username` — identifies which school's username namespace to search. Optional when using `email` — omit on the first call; if the user has more than one active membership the response is `kind: select_school`, and the client retries with a slug.

200.description: Session created (`kind: success`) or a school picker (`kind: select_school`, no session).

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive user, or no active membership.

429.description: More than 5 failed attempts from this IP in 15 minutes.

post.description: Deletes the current session row and clears the cookie. Allowed even when `mustChangePassword` is set. Idempotent: no session cookie is not an error from the client's perspective (the route still requires a live session).

Requires the **current** password, not just a session — a stolen cookie cannot change the password. On success `mustChangePassword` is cleared and every other session of this user is deleted. This route is reachable while `mustChangePassword` is set.

newPassword.description: At least 10 characters; must differ from the current password

400.description: Same password, no password set, or validation failure.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the current password is wrong.

get.summary: Current identity, school, roles, and permissions
get.description: Everything the client needs to render the session: the user, the active school, role keys, the effective permission set (union of all roles), and whether a password change is required. Allowed while `mustChangePassword` is set so the frontend can detect the state.

post.summary: Invite a member to this school
post.description: Requires `users:create`. Creates a user (returning a one-time `temporaryPassword`) or links an existing user to this school without one. Every requested role must be ranked strictly below the caller and grant only permissions the caller holds. At least one of `email` or `username` is required. The actor cannot assign a role at or above their own rank. Body is `.strict()`: unknown fields are rejected.

400.description: Validation failure, or a role key that does not exist at this school (`UNKNOWN_ROLE`).

403.description: Missing `users:create`, or a role the caller cannot assign.

409.description: Already a member (`ALREADY_MEMBER`) or username taken at this school (`USERNAME_TAKEN`).

get.description: Requires `users:read`. Offset-paginated; `limit` is clamped to 100 by the server. Ordered by newest membership first with `id` as a tiebreaker.
Requires `users:read`. `{id}` is a membership ID. A membership in another school returns the same `404 NOT_FOUND` as a nonexistent one — no cross-school probing.

404.description: No such member in this school.

patch.description: Requires `users:update`. Requires a strictly higher rank than the target, and rejects self-targeting (use `/me`). Email changes are refused for users who belong to another school (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`), because one school must not be able to take over an identity used elsewhere.

403.description: Missing `users:update`, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

409.description: Username taken (`USERNAME_TAKEN`) or shared account (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`).

post.description: Requires `users:reset_password` and a strictly higher rank. Sets a new password, forces a change on next login, and deletes every session of the target. Refused for multi-school users (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`) — only they may change their own password. Self-targeting is rejected; use `/auth/change-password`.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

409.description: The user belongs to another school (`SHARED_ACCOUNT`).

post.summary: Suspend a member at this school
post.description: Requires `users:suspend` and a strictly higher rank. Sets the **membership** status to suspended and deletes sessions whose active membership is this row; sessions at other schools survive. Cannot suspend yourself. Owners cannot be suspended because no rank is strictly above theirs.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

post.description: Requires `users:suspend` (same capability as suspending) and a strictly higher rank. Idempotent: an already-active membership is a no-op. No sessions are created; the member logs in again.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, or self-target.

404.description: No such member in this school.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a member
delete.description: Requires `roles:assign` and a strictly higher rank. Self-targeting is rejected. Removing the owner role is guarded by a last-owner check; through the API the self-check and strict rank mean owners cannot remove an owner role at all. Returns 204 even when the member did not hold the role (idempotent, no audit row).

403.description: Missing `roles:assign`, rank too low, self-target, or last owner.

404.description: No such member or role in this school.

get.description: Requires `roles:read`. Returns every role defined for the caller's school, ordered by rank ascending. Roles are per-school rows; the list can differ from another school's. Permission arrays are omitted here and loaded only by the role-detail edit response.

post.summary: Assign a role to a member
post.description: Requires `roles:assign`. `{id}` is a membership ID. The caller must hold a strictly higher rank than the target **and** than the role, and must hold every permission the role grants (you cannot grant a capability you lack). Self-assignment is forbidden. Idempotent: re-assigning a held role is a no-op.

400.description: Validation failure or unknown role key.

403.description: Missing `roles:assign`, rank too low, permission subset violation, or self-target.

404.description: No such member or role in this school.

put.description: Requires `roles:manage_permissions`. The caller must outrank the role. Every permission in the new set must be one the caller holds — otherwise permission editing becomes a privilege-escalation path. Removing permissions is always allowed. The **owner** role is immutable: its permissions always equal the full catalogue, so a school cannot make itself unadministrable. The response includes the updated permissions.

200.description: Updated role with its permission set.

400.description: Unknown permission string, duplicates, or empty set.

403.description: Missing permission, rank too low, owner role, or granting a permission the caller lacks.

404.description: No such role in this school.

get.summary: List audit rows for this school
get.description: Requires `audit:read`. Newest first, cursor-paginated. Always scoped to the caller's school — another school's rows are not observable. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` to continue. Snapshots are field-picked; password hashes, tokens, IPs, and user agents are never returned. System actions have `actor.name: "System"` and a null `actor.membershipId`.

200.description: A page of audit rows and the next cursor.

400.description: Unknown query parameter (`VALIDATION_ERROR`) or malformed cursor (`INVALID_CURSOR`).

post.description: Requires `calendar:manage` and an explicit `confirm: true`. The term must be `planned` and its session unlocked. For term N > 1, term N-1 must exist and be closed. If another term is active, it is closed in the same transaction before the target activates. The school-row lock serializes concurrent calendar mutations; the one-active-term partial unique index is the database backstop.

400.description: Malformed term ID, or a missing prior term (`TERM_SEQUENCE_BROKEN`).

404.description: Term not found in this school.

409.description: Session locked (`SESSION_LOCKED`), invalid transition, prior term not closed (`TERM_NOT_SEQUENTIAL`), or another term active (`TERM_ALREADY_ACTIVE`).

post.description: Requires `calendar:manage` and an explicit `confirm: true`. Only `active → closed` is allowed. Closing a term does not make its results immutable; corrections go through result versions when that module exists.

400.description: Malformed term ID, validation failure, or missing confirmation.

404.description: Term not found in this school.

409.description: The term is not active, or the transition is not allowed.

post.description: Requires `calendar:manage`. Every term in the session must already be `closed`. Sets `closed_at`, which gates new session-scoped writes. The lock is an explicit act, not a state derived from the terms. Reopening requires a reason.

404.description: Academic session not found in this school.

409.description: Session already locked, or one or more terms are not closed.

post.description: Requires `calendar:unlock` (owner-only by default), plus a reason (10–500 chars) recorded in the audit log. Clears `closed_at`; it does not reopen any term. Ended enrolments stay ended.

400.description: Malformed session ID, or a missing/too-short reason.

404.description: Academic session not found in this school.

409.description: Session is not locked.

get.description: Requires `academics:read`. Ordered by term number.

post.description: Requires `calendar:manage`. Takes the school then session lock, validates real dates, refuses a locked session, and refuses overlapping dates.

404.description: Session not found in this school.

409.description: Overlapping dates, duplicate number, or locked session.

patch.description: Requires `calendar:manage`. Updates name/dates, rechecks real dates and overlap excluding this term, and refuses a locked session.

404.description: Term not found in this school.

409.description: Overlapping dates or locked session.

post.description: Requires `calendar:manage`. The label must be `YYYY/YYYY` and the second year must be the first plus one. Duplicate labels in the same school return 409.

409.description: Label already exists at this school.

get.description: Requires `academics:read`. Newest label first.
Requires `academics:read`. Returns the active term's session, else the most recent session by label. `closed_at` is ignored; writability is a separate guard.

patch.description: Requires `calendar:manage`. Validates the label and consecutive years; duplicate labels return 409.

404.description: Session not found in this school.

409.description: Label already exists at this school.

post.summary: Roll a session's classes and offerings into another session
post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. `{id}` is the source session; the body names the open target session. Classes are cloned first, then elective groups, then active offerings. Idempotent: a second run inserts nothing.

400.description: Same source and target session or invalid body.

404.description: Source or target session not found in this school.

409.description: Target session is locked.

post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. The session must be open (not locked) and the level must be live. Junior levels accept only `general`; senior levels accept `science`, `arts`, or `commercial`. A duplicate `(session, level, arm, track)` returns `CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS`.

400.description: Validation failure or an invalid track for the level's stage (`INVALID_TRACK`).

404.description: Session or level not found in this school.

409.description: Duplicate live class (`CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS`), archived class occupying the tuple (`CLASS_ARCHIVED_EXISTS`), archived level, or locked session.

get.description: Requires `academics:read`. `sessionId` is required. Live classes only by default; `includeArchived=true` additionally requires `structure:manage`. Returns each class with its level.

schema.description: Academic session to list classes for. Required.

parameters.description: Academic session to list classes for. Required.
parameters.name: sessionId

schema.description: Include archived classes. Requires `structure:manage`; a reader without it gets 403. Defaults to false.

parameters.description: Include archived classes. Requires `structure:manage`; a reader without it gets 403. Defaults to false.
parameters.name: includeArchived

400.description: Missing `sessionId` or an invalid/unknown query parameter.

patch.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Only `armLabel` and `track` can change. Archived classes are read-only (`CLASS_ARCHIVED`); a live class under an archived level is also read-only (`LEVEL_ARCHIVED`). Track changes are validated against the level's stage.

400.description: Validation failure, empty update, or invalid track.

404.description: Class not found in this school.

409.description: Duplicate class, archived class, or archived level.

get.description: Requires `academics:read`. Returns the class with its level. Cross-school IDs return 404.

404.description: Class not found in this school.

post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Idempotent: archiving an archived class returns 200 without a second timestamp or audit row. The dependency guard is a placeholder until offerings and enrolments land in 2b.

404.description: Class not found in this school.

post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Refused with `LEVEL_ARCHIVED` if the parent level is archived. Idempotent: unarchiving a live class returns 200 without a write or audit row.

200.description: Class is live (or was already live).

404.description: Class or its level not found.

409.description: The parent level is archived (`LEVEL_ARCHIVED`).

post.summary: Clone live classes into another session
post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Copies live classes at the same level, arm and track into an open target session. Archived classes and classes whose level is archived are skipped and reported. Idempotent.

400.description: Validation failure or same source/target session.

404.description: Source or target session not found in this school.

409.description: Target session is locked.

post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Level names are trimmed and unique within the school; `sequence` must be unique and at most 32767. Duplicate name/sequence returns 409.

409.description: Duplicate name (`LEVEL_NAME_TAKEN`) or sequence (`LEVEL_SEQUENCE_TAKEN`).

get.description: Requires `academics:read`. Live levels only by default, ordered by sequence. Passing `includeArchived=true` additionally requires `structure:manage`.

schema.description: Include archived levels. Requires `structure:manage`; a reader without it gets 403. Defaults to false.

parameters.description: Include archived levels. Requires `structure:manage`; a reader without it gets 403. Defaults to false.
parameters.name: includeArchived

patch.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Archived levels are read-only (`LEVEL_ARCHIVED`); unarchive first. Duplicate name/sequence returns 409. A cross-school ID returns the same 404 as a nonexistent one.

404.description: Level not found in this school.

409.description: Duplicate name/sequence, or the level is archived.

get.description: Requires `academics:read`. Cross-school IDs return 404.

404.description: Level not found in this school.

post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Refused with `LEVEL_HAS_ACTIVE_CLASSES` while a live class references the level. Idempotent: archiving an archived level returns 200 without writing a second timestamp or audit row.

404.description: Level not found in this school.

409.description: Live classes still reference this level (`LEVEL_HAS_ACTIVE_CLASSES`).

post.description: Requires `structure:manage`. Idempotent: unarchiving a live level returns 200 without a write or audit row.

200.description: Level is live (or was already live).

404.description: Level not found in this school.

post.summary: Assign or replace the form teacher
post.description: Requires `assignments:manage`. The target must be an active staff-kind member of this school. The class session must be unlocked. Replacing writes before/after audit.

403.description: Missing permission or target is not active staff.

404.description: Class or member not found in this school.

409.description: Class archived or session locked.

post.summary: Assign or replace a subject teacher
post.description: Requires `assignments:manage`. Ends the offering's active assignment(s) and creates the new active row in one transaction. The target must be active staff-kind. Session must be unlocked.

403.description: Missing permission or target is not active staff.

404.description: Offering or member not found in this school.

409.description: Class archived or session locked.

get.description: Staff-kind members only. Returns the active session, form-teacher classes, and taught offerings with names. Student and guardian members receive 403 STAFF_ONLY.

409.description: Subject code already in use.

get.description: Archived subjects are hidden by default; includeArchived=true requires structure:manage.

403.description: Insufficient permission, or includeArchived without structure:manage.

404.description: Subject not found.

409.description: Subject archived, or code collision.

post.description: Idempotent. Refused with SUBJECT_HAS_OFFERINGS if any class offers this subject.

404.description: Subject not found.

409.description: Subject has active offerings.

post.description: Requires structure:manage. The class must exist in the caller's school. Group name is unique per class.

404.description: Class not found.

409.description: Group name already exists in this class.

get.summary: List elective groups for a class
get.description: `classId` is required. Archived groups are hidden by default; `includeArchived=true` requires structure:manage.

403.description: Insufficient permission, or includeArchived without structure:manage.

404.description: Class not found in this school.

patch.description: Updates name and/or choice bounds. If only one bound is provided, the other stays; the service still enforces maxChoices >= minChoices across the merged result.

400.description: Validation failure, or merged bounds are invalid.

404.description: Elective group not found.

409.description: Group is archived.

post.description: Idempotent. Refused with ELECTIVE_GROUP_HAS_OFFERINGS if any class_subjects row references this group.

404.description: Elective group not found.

409.description: Group still has offerings assigned.

post.description: Bulk insert. The class must be in an open session and not archived. Any archived subject in the batch rejects the whole request (atomic). A compulsory offering cannot carry an electiveGroupId. Compulsory offerings auto-enroll every active enrollment in the class.

404.description: Class, subject, or elective group not found.

409.description: Class archived, session locked, or offering already exists.

get.description: Archived offerings are hidden by default; includeArchived=true requires structure:manage.

403.description: Insufficient permission, or includeArchived without structure:manage.

404.description: Class not found in this school.

delete.description: Hard delete. Drops every student_subjects row that references this offering, then deletes the offering itself. Refused if the session is locked or the class is archived.

404.description: Offering not found in this school.

409.description: Class archived, or session locked.

post.description: Creates a user, a membership in the caller's school, assigns the student role, and creates the student profile with the given admission number. The email must be unique across the system; the admission number must be unique within this school. Requires users:create.

409.description: Email already in use, membership already a student, or admission number taken.

get.summary: List active enrollments in the actor's scope
get.description: Requires `enrollments:read`. When `classId` is supplied, a class outside the actor's scope returns 404. Without it, the list is filtered to the actor's assigned classes; a teacher with no assignments receives an empty list. Out-of-scope is 404, not 403.

404.description: Class is outside the actor's scope or does not exist.

post.summary: Enroll a student in a class
post.description: Creates one active enrollment and auto-enrolls the student in every compulsory offering of the class. Refused if the student already has an active enrollment in the same session.

404.description: Class or student not found in this school.

409.description: Class archived, session locked, or student already enrolled in this session.

get.description: Requires `enrollments:read`. The enrollment is loaded first, then its class is checked against scope. Out-of-scope returns 404 ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.

404.description: Enrollment not found or outside scope.

post.description: All-or-nothing. One invalid student rolls back the whole batch. Pass `dryRun: true` to preview without persisting — the same code runs, the transaction is rolled back, and the response reflects what *would* have happened (real UUIDs in the response are not persisted).

404.description: Class or a student not found.

409.description: Class archived, session locked, or a student already enrolled.

post.description: Replaces the student's elective choices atomically. Blocking problems (TOO_MANY, unknown offering, etc.) return 409 with details; incomplete selections (TOO_FEW) are saved with `complete: false`. Compulsory and extra-subject rows are untouched.

404.description: Enrollment not found (or ended).

409.description: Blocking selection problems, archived class, or locked session.

post.summary: Transfer an enrollment to another class
post.description: Ends the current enrollment (status='transferred', ended_at=now) and creates a new one in the target class. Old student_subjects rows are preserved; target compulsory subjects are auto-created. Ordering is enforced by the transaction: the old row must end before the new one inserts.

404.description: Enrollment or target class not found.

409.description: Enrollment not active, class archived, session locked, same class, or student already in the target session.

post.description: Terminal state — ends the enrollment (status='withdrawn', ended_at=now, ended_reason=reason). No replacement enrollment is created. Student_subjects rows are preserved unchanged.

404.description: Enrollment not found.

409.description: Enrollment not active, class archived, session locked, or empty reason.

get.summary: List the active roster of a class
get.description: Returns every student currently enrolled in the class (active enrollments only — transferred and withdrawn students are excluded). Ordered by last name, then first name. Read-only; no writes, no audit.

404.description: Class not found in this school.

get.description: Requires `enrollments:manage`. Read-only. Returns suggestions grouped by target class, with `NO_OFFERINGS`, `CHOOSE_TRACK`, `NO_MATCHING_CLASS`, and graduation outcomes.

404.description: Session not found.

post.description: Requires `enrollments:manage`. Validates every row before writing, locks the school, ends source enrolments, creates target enrolments and compulsory subjects, and reports already-promoted students.

400.description: Invalid plan or earlier target session.

404.description: Session, enrollment or class not found.

409.description: Locked session, archived class, or target class without offerings.

post.description: Requires `users:create`. Frontend parses CSV and sends JSON rows. Returns every problem with its 1-based row number; writes nothing.

400.description: Rows are not an array or exceed the 200-row cap.

post.description: Requires `users:create` and `enrollments:manage`. Saves all rows in one transaction, creates students and enrolments, and returns one-time credentials. Any validation problem saves nothing.

400.description: Validation failure or more than 200 rows.

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is accepting requests. It does not query the database; a deploy check that needs readiness should verify a data-backed endpoint after login.
